description: Source code for the local cache layer of post storage in Mattermost, including cache invalidation, retrieval, and update methods.

classes.name: LocalCachePostStore
classes.description: A struct that extends PostStore with caching capabilities for posts, including cache invalidation and retrieval methods.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateLastPostTime
methods.description: Handles invalidation of last post time cache based on cluster messages.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateLastPosts
methods.description: Handles invalidation of last posts cache based on cluster messages.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidatePostsUsage
methods.description: Handles invalidation of posts usage cache based on cluster messages.

methods.name: ClearCaches
methods.description: Clears all caches related to post data and updates cache invalidation metrics.

methods.name: InvalidateLastPostTimeCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for last post time and last posts for specific channels.

methods.name: GetEtag
methods.description: Retrieves an ETag for a channel, optionally including translation update times.

methods.name: GetPostsSince
methods.description: Fetches posts since a specified time, utilizing cache if allowed.

methods.name: GetPosts
methods.description: Retrieves posts with caching for common limits (30, 60) to optimize performance.

methods.name: AnalyticsPostCount
methods.description: Returns post count for analytics, utilizing cache when appropriate.
